## What This Site Is
The personal portfolio website of Arpit Sachdeva, hosted at https://arpitsachdeva.is-a.dev. It is a single-page web application presenting his education, projects, technical skills, certifications, work experience, and contact channels.

## Projects Listed on the Site
1. YouTube Remote Control System
   - Type: Full-Stack Web App
   - Tech Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, Socket.io, Google OAuth 2.0, YouTube Data API v3
   - Description: Real-time remote control web app to search, play, and pause YouTube across desktop and mobile with WebSocket live sync, QR-code device pairing, and LAN IP detection.
   - Code: https://github.com/god1arpit/youtube-controler

2. BuildTrack
   - Type: Construction Management Platform
   - Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI
   - Description: Multi-role platform (builder / supervisor / labour) with attendance tracking, automated wage engine, expense management, site photo reporting, and JWT auth with RBAC (fixed a role-escalation vulnerability on public registration). Includes a road-inspection AI module (segmentation model trained on IIIT Hyderabad IDD and Mapillary Vistas datasets).
   - Live: https://buildtrack-ai.vercel.app

3. Netflix Content Recommender
   - Type: Machine Learning
   - Tech Stack: Python, TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity
   - Description: Content-based recommender built during the Auspify ML internship, using TF-IDF + cosine similarity over 8,790 Netflix titles; 93% of recommendations share a genre with the query title.

4. HYDRO GUARD
   - Type: IoT & Automation (Patent Filed)
   - Tech Stack: IoT, Automation, Sensors, C++
   - Description: Smart IoT-based automated water overflow control for reservoirs. Patent application filed with the Indian Patent Office (App No. 202511113771), November 2025.

5. Collegia App Redesign
   - Type: UI/UX Redesign
   - Tech Stack: Figma, Design System
   - Description: Redesign of the Collegia app interface with user flows for attendance, marks, CGPA, and timetable tracking.
